steps.message:
# Prove Cauchy's theorem in Isabelle/Isar from the basic group axioms

`/app/Cauchy.lean` is one Lean 4 (Mathlib) proof of Cauchy's theorem: if a prime `p` divides the
order of a finite group `G`, then `G` has an element of order `p`. It is a reference, not a
template. Your only task is to prove the Isabelle theorem in `/app/Cauchy.thy`, by any route you
like, within the requirements below.

`/app/Group_Axioms.thy` defines a locale `grp` from the basic axioms only: closure, associativity,
a **left** identity `e` and **left** inverses `ginv`. It also defines `prime` (from divisibility)
and natural powers `pow x n` (`pow x 0 = e`, `pow x (Suc n) = x \<cdot> pow x n`). Every other group
fact you need (right identity, right inverses, cancellation, laws of powers, ...) must be derived
from these axioms in your own file. `Main` provides only general mathematics: sets, `finite`,
`card`, lists, natural-number arithmetic, `dvd`, `gcd`, and function iteration `f ^^ n`.

`/app/Cauchy.thy` states the theorem and ends in `sorry`. Replace the `sorry` with a complete proof.
Isabelle2025 is installed (`isabelle` is on `PATH`) with a prebuilt `HOL` heap; check your work
from `/app` with:

```sh
timeout 300 isabelle build -o threads=2 -D /app
```

## Working in the sandbox

- Only `/app/Cauchy.thy` is graded; nothing else in the sandbox is kept. Keep your current best
  version there as you go.
- You have 60 minutes.
- `isabelle build` prints nothing until the session finishes, and a looping `simp`/`auto`/`blast` can
  run indefinitely. Wrap builds in `timeout`, e.g. `timeout 300 isabelle build -o threads=2 -D /app`.
  The grader allows 8 minutes for the whole build.
- `isabelle process` may not exit on its own; use `isabelle build`.

## Requirements

- Keep the theory name and the statement `theorem (in grp) cauchy: assumes ... shows ...`
  unchanged (you may name the assumptions). You may add your own definitions and lemmas before it.
- Allowed imports: `Main` and `Group_Axioms` only. Do not modify `/app/Group_Axioms.thy` or
  `/app/ROOT`; the grader uses its own copies.
- `/app/Cauchy.thy` must be at most **750 lines** in total.
- Write the proof in structured Isar: `proof ... qed` blocks built from named facts and
  `have`/`show`/`obtain` steps (`from`, `with`, `hence`, `thus`, `also`/`finally`, `moreover` are
  all fine), with at least four such steps in the proof of `cauchy` itself. It should read like a
  textbook argument, with the key ideas stated as their own lemmas.
- Forbidden anywhere in the file: `apply`-style scripts (`apply`, `done`, `back`, `defer`, `prefer`), `sorry`, `oops`, `smt`, `sledgehammer`, `nitpick`, `nunchaku`, `quickcheck`, `axiomatization`, `axioms`, `oracle`, `skip_proofs`, `quick_and_dirty`, `tactic`, `raw_tactic`, and every ML, setup, syntax and translation command (`ML`, `ML_*`, `SML_*`, `setup`, `local_setup`, `method_setup`, `attribute_setup`, `simproc_setup`, `declaration`, `syntax_declaration`, `syntax`, `no_syntax`, `translations`, `*_translation`). Comments, cartouches and strings are not scanned.
  Ordinary methods such as `metis`, `meson`, `rule`, `simp`, `auto`, `blast`, `arith`, `unfold`, `.` and `..` are
  allowed.

theory Group_Axioms
  imports Main
begin

text \<open>A group given only by the basic axioms: closure, associativity, a left identity and left
  inverses. Nothing else about groups is available; right-sided laws must be derived.\<close>

locale grp =
  fixes G :: "'a set"
    and mult :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"  (infixl \<open>\<cdot>\<close> 70)
    and e :: 'a
    and ginv :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  assumes closed: "\<lbrakk>x \<in> G; y \<in> G\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> x \<cdot> y \<in> G"
    and assoc: "\<lbrakk>x \<in> G; y \<in> G; z \<in> G\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> (x \<cdot> y) \<cdot> z = x \<cdot> (y \<cdot> z)"
    and unit_closed: "e \<in> G"
    and left_unit: "x \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> e \<cdot> x = x"
    and inv_closed: "x \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> ginv x \<in> G"
    and left_inv: "x \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> ginv x \<cdot> x = e"

text \<open>Primality from first principles (\<open>Main\<close> has no notion of primes).\<close>

definition prime :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "prime p \<longleftrightarrow> 1 < p \<and> (\<forall>d. d dvd p \<longrightarrow> d = 1 \<or> d = p)"

text \<open>Natural-number powers \<open>x\<^sup>n = x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> (\<dots> \<cdot> e))\<close>, and their name inside the locale.\<close>

primrec gpow :: "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "gpow m u x 0 = u"
| "gpow m u x (Suc n) = m x (gpow m u x n)"

abbreviation (in grp) pow :: "'a \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "pow x n \<equiv> gpow mult e x n"

end
----
theory Cauchy
  imports Group_Axioms
begin

theorem (in grp) cauchy:
  assumes "finite G" and "prime p" and "p dvd card G"
  shows "\<exists>x\<in>G. pow x p = e \<and> (\<forall>k. 0 < k \<longrightarrow> k < p \<longrightarrow> pow x k \<noteq> e)"
  sorry

end

import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Sylow

/-- Cauchy's theorem: if a prime `p` divides the order of a finite group, some element has
order `p`. -/
theorem cauchy (G : Type*) [Group G] [Fintype G] (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (hdvd : p ∣ Fintype.card G) : ∃ x : G, orderOf x = p := by
  have hcard0 : Fintype.card G ≠ 0 := Fintype.card_ne_zero
  -- write |G| = p^e * m with p ∤ m
  obtain ⟨e, m, hm, hem⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_pow_mul_and_not_dvd hcard0 p hp.out.ne_one
  have he : e ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp only [pow_zero, one_mul] at hem
    exact hm (hem ▸ hdvd)
  -- a subgroup of order p^e
  have hpe : p ^ e ∣ Nat.card G := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hem]; exact Dvd.intro _ rfl
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := Sylow.exists_subgroup_card_pow_prime p hpe
  -- K is nontrivial, so it has an element x ≠ 1
  have hKnt : Nontrivial K := by
    rw [← Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial, hK]
    exact Nat.one_lt_pow he hp.out.one_lt
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ne (1 : K)
  -- its order is a power p^j of p, with j ≥ 1
  have hdiv : orderOf x ∣ p ^ e := hK ▸ orderOf_dvd_natCard x
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hxj⟩ := (Nat.dvd_prime_pow hp.out).mp hdiv
  have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hx (orderOf_eq_one_iff.mp (by simpa using hxj))
  -- y = x^(p^(j-1)) has order p
  have hpdvd : p ∣ orderOf x := by
    rw [hxj]; exact dvd_pow_self p hj0
  have hord : orderOf (x ^ (orderOf x / p)) = p :=
    orderOf_pow_orderOf_div (orderOf_pos x).ne' hpdvd
  refine ⟨((x ^ (orderOf x / p) : K) : G), ?_⟩
  rw [Subgroup.orderOf_coe, hord]

#print axioms cauchy

theory Cauchy
  imports Group_Axioms
begin

text \<open>
  Proof plan (the classical counting proof of Cauchy's theorem).

  Let \<open>S\<close> be the set of \<open>p\<close>-tuples \<open>(x\<^sub>1, \<dots>, x\<^sub>p)\<close> of elements of \<open>G\<close> with
  product \<open>e\<close>.  Its size is \<open>|G|^(p-1)\<close>, which is divisible by \<open>p\<close>.  The cyclic
  rotation acts on \<open>S\<close> with order dividing \<open>p\<close>, so the number of fixed points is
  divisible by \<open>p\<close> as well.  The constant tuple \<open>(e, \<dots>, e)\<close> is a fixed point, hence there
  is a second fixed point \<open>(x, \<dots>, x)\<close> with \<open>x \<noteq> e\<close> and \<open>x\<^sup>p = e\<close>.  Since \<open>p\<close> is prime,
  \<open>x\<close> has order exactly \<open>p\<close>.
\<close>

section \<open>Iterates of a function\<close>

lemma it_split: "(f ^^ (a + b)) x = (f ^^ a) ((f ^^ b) x)"
  by (simp add: funpow_add)

lemma it_fix: "f y = y \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ m) y = y"
  by (induct m) auto

lemma it_add:
  assumes ha: "(f ^^ a) z = z" and hb: "(f ^^ b) z = z"
  shows "(f ^^ (a + b)) z = z"
  by (simp add: it_split hb ha)

lemma it_mult:
  assumes ha: "(f ^^ a) z = z"
  shows "(f ^^ (a * k)) z = z"
proof (induct k)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc k)
  have "(f ^^ (a * Suc k)) z = (f ^^ (a * k + a)) z"
    by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  also have "\<dots> = z"
    by (rule it_add[OF Suc.hyps ha])
  finally show ?case .
qed

lemma it_sub:
  assumes ha: "(f ^^ a) z = z" and hb: "(f ^^ b) z = z" and hle: "b \<le> a"
  shows "(f ^^ (a - b)) z = z"
proof -
  have e1: "(f ^^ ((a - b) + b)) z = (f ^^ a) z"
    by (simp add: hle)
  have e2: "(f ^^ ((a - b) + b)) z = (f ^^ (a - b)) z"
    by (simp add: it_split hb)
  show ?thesis by (metis e1 e2 ha)
qed

text \<open>The stabiliser of a point is closed under gcd (Euclid's algorithm).\<close>

lemma it_gcd: "(f ^^ a) z = z \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ b) z = z \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd a b) z = z"
proof (induct a b rule: gcd_nat_induct)
  case (base m)
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (step m n hpos ih)
  show ?case
  proof (intro impI)
    assume hm: "(f ^^ m) z = z" and hn: "(f ^^ n) z = z"
    have h1: "(f ^^ (n * (m div n))) z = z"
      by (rule it_mult[OF hn])
    have h2: "(f ^^ (m mod n + n * (m div n))) z = (f ^^ (m mod n)) z"
      by (simp add: it_split h1)
    have h3: "m mod n + n * (m div n) = m"
      using div_mult_mod_eq[of m n] by (simp add: add.commute)
    have hmod: "(f ^^ (m mod n)) z = z"
      using h2 h3 hm by (metis)
    have "(f ^^ gcd n (m mod n)) z = z"
      using ih hn hmod by blast
    moreover have "gcd m n = gcd n (m mod n)"
      by (rule gcd_non_0_nat) (use hpos in simp)
    ultimately show "(f ^^ gcd m n) z = z" by simp
  qed
qed

lemma prime_gcd1: "prime p \<Longrightarrow> 0 < k \<Longrightarrow> k < p \<Longrightarrow> gcd k p = 1"
proof -
  assume pp: "prime p" and k0: "0 < k" and kp: "k < p"
  have hp: "\<forall>d. d dvd p \<longrightarrow> d = 1 \<or> d = p"
    using pp unfolding prime_def by blast
  have d: "gcd k p dvd p" by simp
  from hp d have "gcd k p = 1 \<or> gcd k p = p" by blast
  moreover have "gcd k p \<noteq> p"
  proof
    assume "gcd k p = p"
    then have "p dvd k" using gcd_dvd1[of k p] by simp
    then have "p \<le> k" using k0 dvd_imp_le by blast
    with kp show False by simp
  qed
  ultimately show ?thesis by blast
qed

lemma prime_fix:
  assumes pp: "prime p" and k0: "0 < k" and kp: "k < p"
    and hk: "(f ^^ k) z = z" and hp: "(f ^^ p) z = z"
  shows "f z = z"
proof -
  have g: "(f ^^ gcd k p) z = z"
    by (rule it_gcd[OF hk hp])
  have g1: "gcd k p = 1"
    by (rule prime_gcd1[OF pp k0 kp])
  have "(f ^^ 1) z = z"
    using g by (simp add: g1)
  then show ?thesis by simp
qed

lemma orbit_inj:
  assumes pp: "prime p" and hij: "i < j" and hjp: "j < p"
    and hx: "(f ^^ p) x = x" and eq: "(f ^^ i) x = (f ^^ j) x"
  shows "f x = x"
proof -
  have e1: "p - i + i = p" using hij hjp by omega
  have e2: "p - i + j = (j - i) + p" using hij hjp by omega
  have s1: "(f ^^ p) x = (f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ i) x)"
    by (metis e1 it_split)
  have s2: "(f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ j) x) = (f ^^ (j - i)) x"
  proof -
    have "(f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ j) x) = (f ^^ (p - i + j)) x"
      by (simp add: it_split)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ ((j - i) + p)) x"
      by (simp add: e2)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (j - i)) ((f ^^ p) x)"
      by (simp add: it_split)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (j - i)) x"
      by (simp add: hx)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have hd: "(f ^^ (j - i)) x = x"
  proof -
    have "x = (f ^^ p) x" by (simp add: hx)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ i) x)" by (rule s1)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ j) x)" by (simp add: eq)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (j - i)) x" by (rule s2)
    finally show ?thesis by simp
  qed
  have d1: "0 < j - i" using hij by omega
  have d2: "j - i < p" using hij hjp by omega
  show ?thesis by (rule prime_fix[OF pp d1 d2 hd hx])
qed

lemma it_inv:
  assumes hS: "\<forall>x\<in>S. f x \<in> S" and hy: "y \<in> S"
  shows "(f ^^ k) y \<in> S"
proof (induct k)
  case 0
  then show ?case by (simp add: hy)
next
  case (Suc k)
  have "(f ^^ Suc k) y = f ((f ^^ k) y)" by simp
  then show ?case using hS Suc.hyps by auto
qed

section \<open>Counting fixed points of a permutation of order dividing a prime\<close>

text \<open>If \<open>f\<close> has \<open>f^p = id\<close> on a finite invariant set \<open>S\<close>, then \<open>|S|\<close> and the
  number of fixed points of \<open>f\<close> in \<open>S\<close> agree modulo \<open>p\<close>.  The proof splits \<open>S\<close>
  into orbits of size \<open>p\<close> (no orbit of size 1 besides the fixed points).\<close>

lemma orbit_decomp:
  fixes f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a" and p :: nat
  assumes pp: "prime p"
  shows "\<forall>S. finite S \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>S. f x \<in> S) \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>S. (f ^^ p) x = x)
           \<longrightarrow> (\<exists>k. card S = card {x\<in>S. f x = x} + p * k)"
proof (intro allI)
  fix S :: "'a set"
  show "finite S \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>S. f x \<in> S) \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>S. (f ^^ p) x = x)
           \<longrightarrow> (\<exists>k. card S = card {x\<in>S. f x = x} + p * k)"
  proof (induct S rule: finite_psubset_induct)
    case (psubset S hfin ih)
    show ?case
    proof (intro impI)
      assume invS: "\<forall>x\<in>S. f x \<in> S" and invP: "\<forall>x\<in>S. (f ^^ p) x = x"
      have hp0: "0 < p" using pp unfolding prime_def by auto
      show "\<exists>k. card S = card {x\<in>S. f x = x} + p * k"
      proof (cases "\<forall>x\<in>S. f x = x")
        case True
        have "{x\<in>S. f x = x} = S" using True by auto
        then have "card S = card {x\<in>S. f x = x} + p * 0" by simp
        then show ?thesis by blast
      next
        case False
        then obtain x0 where x0S: "x0 \<in> S" and fx0: "f x0 \<noteq> x0" by blast
        have hpx: "(f ^^ p) x0 = x0" using invP x0S by blast
        define O where "O = (\<lambda>k. (f ^^ k) x0) ` {..<p}"
        have Ofin: "finite O" unfolding O_def by simp
        have Oin: "O \<subseteq> S"
          unfolding O_def using invS x0S by (auto intro: it_inv)
        have x0O: "x0 \<in> O"
          unfolding O_def by (rule image_eqI[where x=0]) (simp_all add: hp0)
        have inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>k. (f ^^ k) x0) {..<p}"
        proof (rule inj_onI)
          fix a b
          assume ha: "a \<in> {..<p}" and hb: "b \<in> {..<p}"
            and eq: "(f ^^ a) x0 = (f ^^ b) x0"
          have ap: "a < p" using ha by simp
          have bp: "b < p" using hb by simp
          show "a = b"
          proof (rule ccontr)
            assume neq: "a \<noteq> b"
            have "f x0 = x0"
            proof (cases "a < b")
              case True
              then show ?thesis using orbit_inj[OF pp True bp hpx eq] .
            next
              case False
              then have blt: "b < a" using neq by linarith
              then show ?thesis using orbit_inj[OF pp blt ap hpx eq[symmetric]] .
            qed
            with fx0 show False by contradiction
          qed
        qed
        have cardO: "card O = p"
          unfolding O_def by (subst card_image[OF inj]) simp
        have Oinv: "\<forall>y\<in>O. f y \<in> O"
        proof (intro ballI)
          fix y assume "y \<in> O"
          then obtain k where kp: "k < p" and yk: "y = (f ^^ k) x0"
            unfolding O_def by auto
          show "f y \<in> O"
          proof (cases "Suc k < p")
            case True
            have "f y = (f ^^ Suc k) x0" using yk by simp
            then show ?thesis unfolding O_def
              by (rule image_eqI[where x="Suc k"]) (simp_all add: True)
          next
            case False
            have "f y = (f ^^ p) x0"
            proof -
              have "k + 1 = p" using kp False by simp
              then have "f y = (f ^^ (k + 1)) x0" using yk by simp
              then show ?thesis using \<open>k + 1 = p\<close> by simp
            qed
            then have "f y = x0" using hpx by simp
            then show ?thesis using x0O by simp
          qed
        qed
        have fixO: "\<forall>y\<in>O. f y \<noteq> y"
        proof (intro ballI notI)
          fix y assume yO: "y \<in> O" and fy: "f y = y"
          then obtain k where kp: "k < p" and yk: "y = (f ^^ k) x0"
            unfolding O_def by auto
          have c1: "(f ^^ (p - k)) y = y" by (rule it_fix[OF fy])
          have c2: "(f ^^ (p - k)) y = x0"
          proof -
            have "p - k + k = p" using kp by simp
            then have "(f ^^ p) x0 = (f ^^ (p - k)) ((f ^^ k) x0)"
              by (metis it_split)
            then show ?thesis using yk hpx by simp
          qed
          have "y = x0" using c1 c2 by simp
          then have "f x0 = x0" using fy by simp
          with fx0 show False by contradiction
        qed
        have Sdiff: "S - O \<subset> S" using x0S x0O by auto
        have invSO: "\<forall>y\<in>S - O. f y \<in> S - O"
        proof (intro ballI)
          fix y assume yS: "y \<in> S - O"
          then have ys: "y \<in> S" and yO: "y \<notin> O" by auto
          have fyS: "f y \<in> S" using invS ys by blast
          have fyO: "f y \<notin> O"
          proof
            assume fyO: "f y \<in> O"
            have back: "(f ^^ (p - 1)) (f y) \<in> O"
              by (rule it_inv[OF Oinv fyO])
            have "(f ^^ (p - 1 + 1)) y = (f ^^ (p - 1)) (f y)"
              by (simp add: it_split)
            moreover have "p - 1 + 1 = p" using hp0 by simp
            ultimately have "(f ^^ (p - 1)) (f y) = y"
              using invP ys by (metis)
            then show False using back yO by simp
          qed
          then show "f y \<in> S - O" using fyS by simp
        qed
        have invP': "\<forall>y\<in>S - O. (f ^^ p) y = y" using invP by auto
        obtain k where kS: "card (S - O) = card {x\<in>S - O. f x = x} + p * k"
          using ih Sdiff \<open>finite S\<close> invSO invP' by blast
        have fixeq: "{x\<in>S - O. f x = x} = {x\<in>S. f x = x}"
          using fixO by auto
        have cardSO: "card S = card (S - O) + p"
        proof -
          have "card (S - O) = card S - card O"
            by (rule card_Diff_subset[OF Ofin Oin])
          moreover have "card O \<le> card S" by (rule card_mono[OF hfin Oin])
          ultimately show ?thesis using cardO by linarith
        qed
        have "card S = card {x\<in>S. f x = x} + p * (k + 1)"
          using cardSO kS fixeq by (simp add: algebra_simps)
        then show ?thesis by blast
      qed
    qed
  qed
qed

section \<open>Basic group facts from the left axioms\<close>

context grp
begin

lemma r_inv: "x \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> x \<cdot> ginv x = e"
proof -
  assume hx: "x \<in> G"
  have hy: "ginv x \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF hx])
  have hz: "ginv (ginv x) \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF hy])
  have h1: "ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> ginv x = e" by (rule left_inv[OF hy])
  have h2: "ginv x \<cdot> x = e" by (rule left_inv[OF hx])
  have hxy: "x \<cdot> ginv x \<in> G" by (rule closed[OF hx hy])
  have "x \<cdot> ginv x = e \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x)" by (simp add: left_unit[OF hxy])
  also have "\<dots> = (ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x)" by (simp add: h1)
  also have "\<dots> = ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> (ginv x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x))"
    by (rule assoc[OF hz hy hxy])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> ((ginv x \<cdot> x) \<cdot> ginv x)"
    by (simp add: assoc[OF hy hx hy])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> (e \<cdot> ginv x)" by (simp add: h2)
  also have "\<dots> = ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> ginv x" by (simp add: left_unit[OF hy])
  also have "\<dots> = e" by (rule h1)
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma r_unit: "x \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> x \<cdot> e = x"
proof -
  assume hx: "x \<in> G"
  have hi: "ginv x \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF hx])
  have "x \<cdot> e = x \<cdot> (ginv x \<cdot> x)" by (simp add: left_inv[OF hx])
  also have "\<dots> = (x \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> x" by (simp add: assoc[OF hx hi hx])
  also have "\<dots> = x" by (simp add: r_inv[OF hx] left_unit[OF hx])
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma uniq_left: "a \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> a \<cdot> y = e \<Longrightarrow> y = ginv a"
proof -
  assume ha: "a \<in> G" and hy: "y \<in> G" and h: "a \<cdot> y = e"
  have hi: "ginv a \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF ha])
  have "y = e \<cdot> y" by (simp add: left_unit[OF hy])
  also have "\<dots> = (ginv a \<cdot> a) \<cdot> y" by (simp add: left_inv[OF ha])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv a \<cdot> (a \<cdot> y)" by (simp add: assoc[OF hi ha hy])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv a" by (simp add: h r_unit[OF hi])
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma fold_mem: "set xs \<subseteq> G \<Longrightarrow> foldr mult xs e \<in> G"
  by (induct xs) (auto intro: closed unit_closed)

lemma fold_snoc: "set xs \<subseteq> G \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> foldr mult (xs @ [y]) e = foldr mult xs e \<cdot> y"
proof (induct xs)
  case Nil
  show ?case
  proof (intro impI)
    assume hy: "y \<in> G"
    show "foldr mult ([] @ [y]) e = foldr mult [] e \<cdot> y"
      by (simp add: r_unit[OF hy] left_unit[OF hy])
  qed
next
  case (Cons x xs)
  show ?case
  proof (intro impI)
    assume hs: "set (x # xs) \<subseteq> G" and hy: "y \<in> G"
    have hx: "x \<in> G" using hs by simp
    have hxs: "set xs \<subseteq> G" using hs by simp
    have hp: "foldr mult xs e \<in> G" by (rule fold_mem[OF hxs])
    have "foldr mult ((x # xs) @ [y]) e = x \<cdot> (foldr mult xs e \<cdot> y)"
      by (simp add: Cons.hyps[OF hxs hy])
    also have "\<dots> = (x \<cdot> foldr mult xs e) \<cdot> y"
      by (simp add: assoc[OF hx hp hy])
    finally show "foldr mult ((x # xs) @ [y]) e = foldr mult (x # xs) e \<cdot> y" by simp
  qed
qed

lemma pow_rep: "foldr mult (replicate n x) e = pow x n"
  by (induct n) simp_all

lemma pow_e: "pow e n = e"
proof (induct n)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  then show ?case by (simp add: left_unit[OF unit_closed])
qed

lemma iter_pow: "((\<lambda>y. x \<cdot> y) ^^ k) e = pow x k"
  by (induct k) simp_all

definition lsts :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a list set"
  where "lsts n = {xs. length xs = n \<and> set xs \<subseteq> G}"

definition SS :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a list set"
  where "SS n = {xs \<in> lsts n. foldr mult xs e = e}"

definition gfun :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a list"
  where "gfun xs = xs @ [ginv (foldr mult xs e)]"

lemma lsts_card:
  assumes fG: "finite G"
  shows "finite (lsts n) \<and> card (lsts n) = card G ^ n"
proof (induct n)
  case 0
  have "lsts 0 = {[]}" unfolding lsts_def by auto
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  have eq: "lsts (Suc n) = (\<lambda>(x, ys). x # ys) ` (G \<times> lsts n)"
  proof (intro equalityI subsetI)
    fix zs assume hz: "zs \<in> lsts (Suc n)"
    then obtain x ys where zs: "zs = x # ys"
      unfolding lsts_def by (cases zs) auto
    show "zs \<in> (\<lambda>(x, ys). x # ys) ` (G \<times> lsts n)"
    proof (rule image_eqI[of _ _ "(x, ys)"])
      show "zs = (\<lambda>(x, ys). x # ys) (x, ys)" using zs by simp
    next
      show "(x, ys) \<in> G \<times> lsts n" using hz zs unfolding lsts_def by auto
    qed
  next
    fix zs assume "zs \<in> (\<lambda>(x, ys). x # ys) ` (G \<times> lsts n)"
    then obtain x ys where hx: "x \<in> G" and hys: "ys \<in> lsts n" and zs: "zs = x # ys"
      by auto
    then show "zs \<in> lsts (Suc n)" unfolding lsts_def by auto
  qed
  have inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>(x, ys). x # ys) (G \<times> lsts n)"
    by (auto simp: inj_on_def)
  have fin: "finite (lsts (Suc n))"
    unfolding eq by (rule finite_imageI) (rule finite_cartesian_product[OF fG conjunct1[OF Suc]])
  have card_eq: "card (lsts (Suc n)) = card G * card (lsts n)"
    unfolding eq by (subst card_image[OF inj]) (simp add: card_cartesian_product)
  show ?case using fin card_eq Suc by (simp add: power_Suc)
qed

lemma SS_card:
  assumes fG: "finite G" and hp: "0 < p"
  shows "finite (SS p) \<and> card (SS p) = card G ^ (p - 1)"
proof -
  have eq: "SS p = gfun ` lsts (p - 1)"
  proof (intro equalityI subsetI)
    fix zs assume hz: "zs \<in> SS p"
    then have mem: "length zs = p \<and> set zs \<subseteq> G \<and> foldr mult zs e = e"
      unfolding SS_def lsts_def by auto
    have hne: "zs \<noteq> []" using mem hp by auto
    define xs where "xs = butlast zs"
    define y where "y = last zs"
    have zs_eq: "zs = xs @ [y]"
      unfolding xs_def y_def using hne by simp
    have hlen: "length xs = p - 1" unfolding xs_def using mem by simp
    have hxs: "set xs \<subseteq> G" unfolding xs_def using mem by (auto dest: in_set_butlastD)
    have hy: "y \<in> G" unfolding y_def using mem hne by (auto intro: last_in_set)
    have hfold: "foldr mult xs e \<cdot> y = e"
      using mem zs_eq fold_snoc[OF hxs hy] by simp
    have hPG: "foldr mult xs e \<in> G" by (rule fold_mem[OF hxs])
    have hyy: "y = ginv (foldr mult xs e)" by (rule uniq_left[OF hPG hy hfold])
    show "zs \<in> gfun ` lsts (p - 1)"
    proof (rule image_eqI[of _ _ xs])
      show "zs = gfun xs" using zs_eq hyy by (simp add: gfun_def)
    next
      show "xs \<in> lsts (p - 1)" using hlen hxs unfolding lsts_def by simp
    qed
  next
    fix zs assume "zs \<in> gfun ` lsts (p - 1)"
    then obtain xs where hx: "xs \<in> lsts (p - 1)" and hz: "zs = gfun xs"
      by blast
    then have hl: "length xs = p - 1" and hs: "set xs \<subseteq> G"
      unfolding lsts_def by auto
    have hPG: "foldr mult xs e \<in> G" by (rule fold_mem[OF hs])
    have hgi: "ginv (foldr mult xs e) \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF hPG])
    have "foldr mult zs e = e"
      by (simp add: hz gfun_def fold_snoc[OF hs hgi] r_inv[OF hPG])
    moreover have "length zs = p" using hz hl hp by (simp add: gfun_def)
    moreover have "set zs \<subseteq> G" using hz hs hgi by (auto simp: gfun_def)
    ultimately show "zs \<in> SS p" unfolding SS_def lsts_def by simp
  qed
  have inj: "inj_on gfun (lsts (p - 1))"
    by (rule inj_onI) (metis butlast_snoc gfun_def)
  have cnt: "finite (lsts (p - 1)) \<and> card (lsts (p - 1)) = card G ^ (p - 1)"
    by (rule lsts_card[OF fG])
  have "finite (SS p)" unfolding eq by (rule finite_imageI) (rule conjunct1[OF cnt])
  moreover have "card (SS p) = card G ^ (p - 1)"
    unfolding eq by (subst card_image[OF inj]) (rule conjunct2[OF cnt])
  ultimately show ?thesis by blast
qed

lemma rot_mem:
  assumes hp: "0 < p" and hx: "xs \<in> SS p"
  shows "rotate1 xs \<in> SS p"
proof -
  have mem: "length xs = p \<and> set xs \<subseteq> G \<and> foldr mult xs e = e"
    using hx unfolding SS_def lsts_def by auto
  obtain x ys where xs: "xs = x # ys"
    using mem hp by (cases xs) auto
  have hxG: "x \<in> G" and hysG: "set ys \<subseteq> G" using mem xs by auto
  have hPy: "foldr mult ys e \<in> G" by (rule fold_mem[OF hysG])
  have hfx: "x \<cdot> foldr mult ys e = e" using mem xs by simp
  have hgy: "foldr mult ys e = ginv x" by (rule uniq_left[OF hxG hPy hfx])
  have hrot: "rotate1 xs = ys @ [x]" using xs by simp
  have hl': "length (ys @ [x]) = p" using mem xs by simp
  have hs': "set (ys @ [x]) \<subseteq> G" using mem xs by auto
  have hf': "foldr mult (ys @ [x]) e = e"
    by (simp add: fold_snoc[OF hysG hxG] hgy left_inv[OF hxG])
  show ?thesis
    unfolding SS_def lsts_def using hrot hl' hs' hf' by simp
qed

end

section \<open>Fixed points of rotation\<close>

lemma fixed_all: "ys @ [x] = x # ys \<Longrightarrow> \<forall>y\<in>set ys. y = x"
  by (induct ys) auto

lemma all_eq_replicate: "\<forall>y\<in>set ys. y = x \<Longrightarrow> ys = replicate (length ys) x"
  by (induct ys) auto

lemma fixed_rot:
  assumes ne: "xs \<noteq> []" and fx: "rotate1 xs = xs"
  shows "xs = replicate (length xs) (hd xs)"
proof -
  obtain x ys where hx: "xs = x # ys" using ne by (cases xs) auto
  have h1: "ys @ [x] = x # ys" using fx hx by simp
  have h2: "\<forall>y\<in>set ys. y = x" using fixed_all[OF h1] .
  have h3: "ys = replicate (length ys) x" using all_eq_replicate[OF h2] .
  have h4: "xs = x # replicate (length ys) x"
    by (subst hx) (rule arg_cong[OF h3, of "Cons x"])
  show ?thesis by (simp add: h4)
qed

lemma rot_iter: "length xs = n \<Longrightarrow> (rotate1 ^^ n) xs = xs"
proof -
  assume hl: "length xs = n"
  have "rotate n xs = xs" by (rule rotate_id) (simp add: hl)
  then show ?thesis by (simp add: rotate_def)
qed

section \<open>Cauchy's theorem\<close>

context grp
begin

theorem cauchy_aux_dummy: True by simp

end

theorem (in grp) cauchy:
  assumes "finite G" and "prime p" and "p dvd card G"
  shows "\<exists>x\<in>G. pow x p = e \<and> (\<forall>k. 0 < k \<longrightarrow> k < p \<longrightarrow> pow x k \<noteq> e)"
  sorry

end

theory Cauchy
  imports Group_Axioms
begin

text \<open>
  Proof plan (the classical counting proof of Cauchy's theorem).

  Let \<open>S\<close> be the set of \<open>p\<close>-tuples \<open>(x\<^sub>1, \<dots>, x\<^sub>p)\<close> of elements of \<open>G\<close> with
  product \<open>e\<close>.  Its size is \<open>|G|^(p-1)\<close>, which is divisible by \<open>p\<close>.  The cyclic
  rotation acts on \<open>S\<close> with order dividing \<open>p\<close>, so the number of fixed points is
  divisible by \<open>p\<close> as well.  The constant tuple \<open>(e, \<dots>, e)\<close> is a fixed point, hence there
  is a second fixed point \<open>(x, \<dots>, x)\<close> with \<open>x \<noteq> e\<close> and \<open>x\<^sup>p = e\<close>.  Since \<open>p\<close> is prime,
  \<open>x\<close> has order exactly \<open>p\<close>.
\<close>

section \<open>Iterates of a function\<close>

lemma it_split: "(f ^^ (a + b)) x = (f ^^ a) ((f ^^ b) x)"
  by (simp add: funpow_add)

lemma it_fix: "f y = y \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ m) y = y"
  by (induct m) auto

lemma it_add:
  assumes ha: "(f ^^ a) z = z" and hb: "(f ^^ b) z = z"
  shows "(f ^^ (a + b)) z = z"
  by (simp add: it_split hb ha)

lemma it_mult:
  assumes ha: "(f ^^ a) z = z"
  shows "(f ^^ (a * k)) z = z"
proof (induct k)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc k)
  have "(f ^^ (a * Suc k)) z = (f ^^ (a * k + a)) z"
    by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  also have "\<dots> = z"
    by (rule it_add[OF Suc.hyps ha])
  finally show ?case .
qed

lemma it_sub:
  assumes ha: "(f ^^ a) z = z" and hb: "(f ^^ b) z = z" and hle: "b \<le> a"
  shows "(f ^^ (a - b)) z = z"
proof -
  have e1: "(f ^^ ((a - b) + b)) z = (f ^^ a) z"
    by (simp add: hle)
  have e2: "(f ^^ ((a - b) + b)) z = (f ^^ (a - b)) z"
    by (simp add: it_split hb)
  show ?thesis by (metis e1 e2 ha)
qed

text \<open>The stabiliser of a point is closed under gcd (Euclid's algorithm).\<close>

lemma it_gcd: "(f ^^ a) z = z \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ b) z = z \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd a b) z = z"
proof (induct a b rule: gcd_nat_induct)
  case (base m)
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (step m n hpos ih)
  show ?case
  proof (intro impI)
    assume hm: "(f ^^ m) z = z" and hn: "(f ^^ n) z = z"
    have h1: "(f ^^ (n * (m div n))) z = z"
      by (rule it_mult[OF hn])
    have h2: "(f ^^ (m mod n + n * (m div n))) z = (f ^^ (m mod n)) z"
      by (simp add: it_split h1)
    have h3: "m mod n + n * (m div n) = m"
      using div_mult_mod_eq[of m n] by (simp add: add.commute)
    have hmod: "(f ^^ (m mod n)) z = z"
      using h2 h3 hm by (metis)
    have "(f ^^ gcd n (m mod n)) z = z"
      using ih hn hmod by blast
    moreover have "gcd m n = gcd n (m mod n)"
      by (rule gcd_non_0_nat) (use hpos in simp)
    ultimately show "(f ^^ gcd m n) z = z" by simp
  qed
qed

lemma prime_gcd1: "prime p \<Longrightarrow> 0 < k \<Longrightarrow> k < p \<Longrightarrow> gcd k p = 1"
proof -
  assume pp: "prime p" and k0: "0 < k" and kp: "k < p"
  have hp: "\<forall>d. d dvd p \<longrightarrow> d = 1 \<or> d = p"
    using pp unfolding prime_def by blast
  have d: "gcd k p dvd p" by simp
  from hp d have "gcd k p = 1 \<or> gcd k p = p" by blast
  moreover have "gcd k p \<noteq> p"
  proof
    assume "gcd k p = p"
    then have "p dvd k" using gcd_dvd1[of k p] by simp
    then have "p \<le> k" using k0 dvd_imp_le by blast
    with kp show False by simp
  qed
  ultimately show ?thesis by blast
qed

lemma prime_fix:
  assumes pp: "prime p" and k0: "0 < k" and kp: "k < p"
    and hk: "(f ^^ k) z = z" and hp: "(f ^^ p) z = z"
  shows "f z = z"
proof -
  have g: "(f ^^ gcd k p) z = z"
    by (rule it_gcd[OF hk hp])
  have g1: "gcd k p = 1"
    by (rule prime_gcd1[OF pp k0 kp])
  have "(f ^^ 1) z = z"
    using g by (simp add: g1)
  then show ?thesis by simp
qed

lemma orbit_inj:
  assumes pp: "prime p" and hij: "i < j" and hjp: "j < p"
    and hx: "(f ^^ p) x = x" and eq: "(f ^^ i) x = (f ^^ j) x"
  shows "f x = x"
proof -
  have e1: "p - i + i = p" using hij hjp by omega
  have e2: "p - i + j = (j - i) + p" using hij hjp by omega
  have s1: "(f ^^ p) x = (f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ i) x)"
    by (metis e1 it_split)
  have s2: "(f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ j) x) = (f ^^ (j - i)) x"
  proof -
    have "(f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ j) x) = (f ^^ (p - i + j)) x"
      by (simp add: it_split)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ ((j - i) + p)) x"
      by (simp add: e2)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (j - i)) ((f ^^ p) x)"
      by (simp add: it_split)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (j - i)) x"
      by (simp add: hx)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have hd: "(f ^^ (j - i)) x = x"
  proof -
    have "x = (f ^^ p) x" by (simp add: hx)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ i) x)" by (rule s1)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ j) x)" by (simp add: eq)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (j - i)) x" by (rule s2)
    finally show ?thesis by simp
  qed
  have d1: "0 < j - i" using hij by omega
  have d2: "j - i < p" using hij hjp by omega
  show ?thesis by (rule prime_fix[OF pp d1 d2 hd hx])
qed

lemma it_inv:
  assumes hS: "\<forall>x\<in>S. f x \<in> S" and hy: "y \<in> S"
  shows "(f ^^ k) y \<in> S"
proof (induct k)
  case 0
  then show ?case by (simp add: hy)
next
  case (Suc k)
  have "(f ^^ Suc k) y = f ((f ^^ k) y)" by simp
  then show ?case using hS Suc.hyps by auto
qed

section \<open>Counting fixed points of a permutation of order dividing a prime\<close>

text \<open>If \<open>f\<close> has \<open>f^p = id\<close> on a finite invariant set \<open>S\<close>, then \<open>|S|\<close> and the
  number of fixed points of \<open>f\<close> in \<open>S\<close> agree modulo \<open>p\<close>.  The proof splits \<open>S\<close>
  into orbits of size \<open>p\<close> (no orbit of size 1 besides the fixed points).\<close>

lemma orbit_decomp:
  fixes f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a" and p :: nat
  assumes pp: "prime p"
  shows "\<forall>S. finite S \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>S. f x \<in> S) \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>S. (f ^^ p) x = x)
           \<longrightarrow> (\<exists>k. card S = card {x\<in>S. f x = x} + p * k)"
proof (intro allI)
  fix S :: "'a set"
  show "finite S \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>S. f x \<in> S) \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>S. (f ^^ p) x = x)
           \<longrightarrow> (\<exists>k. card S = card {x\<in>S. f x = x} + p * k)"
  proof (induct S rule: finite_psubset_induct)
    case (psubset S hfin ih)
    show ?case
    proof (intro impI)
      assume invS: "\<forall>x\<in>S. f x \<in> S" and invP: "\<forall>x\<in>S. (f ^^ p) x = x"
      have hp0: "0 < p" using pp unfolding prime_def by auto
      show "\<exists>k. card S = card {x\<in>S. f x = x} + p * k"
      proof (cases "\<forall>x\<in>S. f x = x")
        case True
        have "{x\<in>S. f x = x} = S" using True by auto
        then have "card S = card {x\<in>S. f x = x} + p * 0" by simp
        then show ?thesis by blast
      next
        case False
        then obtain x0 where x0S: "x0 \<in> S" and fx0: "f x0 \<noteq> x0" by blast
        have hpx: "(f ^^ p) x0 = x0" using invP x0S by blast
        define O where "O = (\<lambda>k. (f ^^ k) x0) ` {..<p}"
        have Ofin: "finite O" unfolding O_def by simp
        have Oin: "O \<subseteq> S"
          unfolding O_def using invS x0S by (auto intro: it_inv)
        have x0O: "x0 \<in> O"
          unfolding O_def by (rule image_eqI[where x=0]) (simp_all add: hp0)
        have inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>k. (f ^^ k) x0) {..<p}"
        proof (rule inj_onI)
          fix a b
          assume ha: "a \<in> {..<p}" and hb: "b \<in> {..<p}"
            and eq: "(f ^^ a) x0 = (f ^^ b) x0"
          have ap: "a < p" using ha by simp
          have bp: "b < p" using hb by simp
          show "a = b"
          proof (rule ccontr)
            assume neq: "a \<noteq> b"
            have "f x0 = x0"
            proof (cases "a < b")
              case True
              then show ?thesis using orbit_inj[OF pp True bp hpx eq] .
            next
              case False
              then have blt: "b < a" using neq by linarith
              then show ?thesis using orbit_inj[OF pp blt ap hpx eq[symmetric]] .
            qed
            with fx0 show False by contradiction
          qed
        qed
        have cardO: "card O = p"
          unfolding O_def by (subst card_image[OF inj]) simp
        have Oinv: "\<forall>y\<in>O. f y \<in> O"
        proof (intro ballI)
          fix y assume "y \<in> O"
          then obtain k where kp: "k < p" and yk: "y = (f ^^ k) x0"
            unfolding O_def by auto
          show "f y \<in> O"
          proof (cases "Suc k < p")
            case True
            have "f y = (f ^^ Suc k) x0" using yk by simp
            then show ?thesis unfolding O_def
              by (rule image_eqI[where x="Suc k"]) (simp_all add: True)
          next
            case False
            have "f y = (f ^^ p) x0"
            proof -
              have "k + 1 = p" using kp False by simp
              then have "f y = (f ^^ (k + 1)) x0" using yk by simp
              then show ?thesis using \<open>k + 1 = p\<close> by simp
            qed
            then have "f y = x0" using hpx by simp
            then show ?thesis using x0O by simp
          qed
        qed
        have fixO: "\<forall>y\<in>O. f y \<noteq> y"
        proof (intro ballI notI)
          fix y assume yO: "y \<in> O" and fy: "f y = y"
          then obtain k where kp: "k < p" and yk: "y = (f ^^ k) x0"
            unfolding O_def by auto
          have c1: "(f ^^ (p - k)) y = y" by (rule it_fix[OF fy])
          have c2: "(f ^^ (p - k)) y = x0"
          proof -
            have "p - k + k = p" using kp by simp
            then have "(f ^^ p) x0 = (f ^^ (p - k)) ((f ^^ k) x0)"
              by (metis it_split)
            then show ?thesis using yk hpx by simp
          qed
          have "y = x0" using c1 c2 by simp
          then have "f x0 = x0" using fy by simp
          with fx0 show False by contradiction
        qed
        have Sdiff: "S - O \<subset> S" using x0S x0O by auto
        have invSO: "\<forall>y\<in>S - O. f y \<in> S - O"
        proof (intro ballI)
          fix y assume yS: "y \<in> S - O"
          then have ys: "y \<in> S" and yO: "y \<notin> O" by auto
          have fyS: "f y \<in> S" using invS ys by blast
          have fyO: "f y \<notin> O"
          proof
            assume fyO: "f y \<in> O"
            have back: "(f ^^ (p - 1)) (f y) \<in> O"
              by (rule it_inv[OF Oinv fyO])
            have "(f ^^ (p - 1 + 1)) y = (f ^^ (p - 1)) (f y)"
              by (simp add: it_split)
            moreover have "p - 1 + 1 = p" using hp0 by simp
            ultimately have "(f ^^ (p - 1)) (f y) = y"
              using invP ys by (metis)
            then show False using back yO by simp
          qed
          then show "f y \<in> S - O" using fyS by simp
        qed
        have invP': "\<forall>y\<in>S - O. (f ^^ p) y = y" using invP by auto
        obtain k where kS: "card (S - O) = card {x\<in>S - O. f x = x} + p * k"
          using ih Sdiff \<open>finite S\<close> invSO invP' by blast
        have fixeq: "{x\<in>S - O. f x = x} = {x\<in>S. f x = x}"
          using fixO by auto
        have cardSO: "card S = card (S - O) + p"
        proof -
          have "card (S - O) = card S - card O"
            by (rule card_Diff_subset[OF Ofin Oin])
          moreover have "card O \<le> card S" by (rule card_mono[OF hfin Oin])
          ultimately show ?thesis using cardO by linarith
        qed
        have "card S = card {x\<in>S. f x = x} + p * (k + 1)"
          using cardSO kS fixeq by (simp add: algebra_simps)
        then show ?thesis by blast
      qed
    qed
  qed
qed

section \<open>Basic group facts from the left axioms\<close>

context grp
begin

lemma r_inv: "x \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> x \<cdot> ginv x = e"
proof -
  assume hx: "x \<in> G"
  have hy: "ginv x \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF hx])
  have hz: "ginv (ginv x) \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF hy])
  have h1: "ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> ginv x = e" by (rule left_inv[OF hy])
  have h2: "ginv x \<cdot> x = e" by (rule left_inv[OF hx])
  have hxy: "x \<cdot> ginv x \<in> G" by (rule closed[OF hx hy])
  have "x \<cdot> ginv x = e \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x)" by (simp add: left_unit[OF hxy])
  also have "\<dots> = (ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x)" by (simp add: h1)
  also have "\<dots> = ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> (ginv x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x))"
    by (rule assoc[OF hz hy hxy])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> ((ginv x \<cdot> x) \<cdot> ginv x)"
    by (simp add: assoc[OF hy hx hy])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> (e \<cdot> ginv x)" by (simp add: h2)
  also have "\<dots> = ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> ginv x" by (simp add: left_unit[OF hy])
  also have "\<dots> = e" by (rule h1)
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma r_unit: "x \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> x \<cdot> e = x"
proof -
  assume hx: "x \<in> G"
  have hi: "ginv x \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF hx])
  have "x \<cdot> e = x \<cdot> (ginv x \<cdot> x)" by (simp add: left_inv[OF hx])
  also have "\<dots> = (x \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> x" by (simp add: assoc[OF hx hi hx])
  also have "\<dots> = x" by (simp add: r_inv[OF hx] left_unit[OF hx])
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma uniq_left: "a \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> a \<cdot> y = e \<Longrightarrow> y = ginv a"
proof -
  assume ha: "a \<in> G" and hy: "y \<in> G" and h: "a \<cdot> y = e"
  have hi: "ginv a \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF ha])
  have "y = e \<cdot> y" by (simp add: left_unit[OF hy])
  also have "\<dots> = (ginv a \<cdot> a) \<cdot> y" by (simp add: left_inv[OF ha])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv a \<cdot> (a \<cdot> y)" by (simp add: assoc[OF hi ha hy])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv a" by (simp add: h r_unit[OF hi])
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma fold_mem: "set xs \<subseteq> G \<Longrightarrow> foldr mult xs e \<in> G"
  by (induct xs) (auto intro: closed unit_closed)

lemma fold_snoc: "set xs \<subseteq> G \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> foldr mult (xs @ [y]) e = foldr mult xs e \<cdot> y"
proof (induct xs)
  case Nil
  show ?case
  proof (intro impI)
    assume hy: "y \<in> G"
    show "foldr mult ([] @ [y]) e = foldr mult [] e \<cdot> y"
      by (simp add: r_unit[OF hy] left_unit[OF hy])
  qed
next
  case (Cons x xs)
  show ?case
  proof (intro impI)
    assume hs: "set (x # xs) \<subseteq> G" and hy: "y \<in> G"
    have hx: "x \<in> G" using hs by simp
    have hxs: "set xs \<subseteq> G" using hs by simp
    have hp: "foldr mult xs e \<in> G" by (rule fold_mem[OF hxs])
    have "foldr mult ((x # xs) @ [y]) e = x \<cdot> (foldr mult xs e \<cdot> y)"
      by (simp add: Cons.hyps[OF hxs hy])
    also have "\<dots> = (x \<cdot> foldr mult xs e) \<cdot> y"
      by (simp add: assoc[OF hx hp hy])
    finally show "foldr mult ((x # xs) @ [y]) e = foldr mult (x # xs) e \<cdot> y" by simp
  qed
qed

lemma pow_rep: "foldr mult (replicate n x) e = pow x n"
  by (induct n) simp_all

lemma pow_e: "pow e n = e"
proof (induct n)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  then show ?case by (simp add: left_unit[OF unit_closed])
qed

lemma iter_pow: "((\<lambda>y. x \<cdot> y) ^^ k) e = pow x k"
  by (induct k) simp_all

definition lsts :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a list set"
  where "lsts n = {xs. length xs = n \<and> set xs \<subseteq> G}"

definition SS :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a list set"
  where "SS n = {xs \<in> lsts n. foldr mult xs e = e}"

definition gfun :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a list"
  where "gfun xs = xs @ [ginv (foldr mult xs e)]"

lemma lsts_card:
  assumes fG: "finite G"
  shows "finite (lsts n) \<and> card (lsts n) = card G ^ n"
proof (induct n)
  case 0
  have "lsts 0 = {[]}" unfolding lsts_def by auto
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  have eq: "lsts (Suc n) = (\<lambda>(x, ys). x # ys) ` (G \<times> lsts n)"
  proof (intro equalityI subsetI)
    fix zs assume hz: "zs \<in> lsts (Suc n)"
    then obtain x ys where zs: "zs = x # ys"
      unfolding lsts_def by (cases zs) auto
    show "zs \<in> (\<lambda>(x, ys). x # ys) ` (G \<times> lsts n)"
    proof (rule image_eqI[of _ _ "(x, ys)"])
      show "zs = (\<lambda>(x, ys). x # ys) (x, ys)" using zs by simp
    next
      show "(x, ys) \<in> G \<times> lsts n" using hz zs unfolding lsts_def by auto
    qed
  next
    fix zs assume "zs \<in> (\<lambda>(x, ys). x # ys) ` (G \<times> lsts n)"
    then obtain x ys where hx: "x \<in> G" and hys: "ys \<in> lsts n" and zs: "zs = x # ys"
      by auto
    then show "zs \<in> lsts (Suc n)" unfolding lsts_def by auto
  qed
  have inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>(x, ys). x # ys) (G \<times> lsts n)"
    by (auto simp: inj_on_def)
  have fin: "finite (lsts (Suc n))"
    unfolding eq by (rule finite_imageI) (rule finite_cartesian_product[OF fG conjunct1[OF Suc]])
  have card_eq: "card (lsts (Suc n)) = card G * card (lsts n)"
    unfolding eq by (subst card_image[OF inj]) (simp add: card_cartesian_product)
  show ?case using fin card_eq Suc by (simp add: power_Suc)
qed

lemma SS_card:
  assumes fG: "finite G" and hp: "0 < p"
  shows "finite (SS p) \<and> card (SS p) = card G ^ (p - 1)"
proof -
  have eq: "SS p = gfun ` lsts (p - 1)"
  proof (intro equalityI subsetI)
    fix zs assume hz: "zs \<in> SS p"
    then have mem: "length zs = p \<and> set zs \<subseteq> G \<and> foldr mult zs e = e"
      unfolding SS_def lsts_def by auto
    have hne: "zs \<noteq> []" using mem hp by auto
    define xs where "xs = butlast zs"
    define y where "y = last zs"
    have zs_eq: "zs = xs @ [y]"
      unfolding xs_def y_def using hne by simp
    have hlen: "length xs = p - 1" unfolding xs_def using mem by simp
    have hxs: "set xs \<subseteq> G" unfolding xs_def using mem by (auto dest: in_set_butlastD)
    have hy: "y \<in> G" unfolding y_def using mem hne by (auto intro: last_in_set)
    have hfold: "foldr mult xs e \<cdot> y = e"
      using mem zs_eq fold_snoc[OF hxs hy] by simp
    have hPG: "foldr mult xs e \<in> G" by (rule fold_mem[OF hxs])
    have hyy: "y = ginv (foldr mult xs e)" by (rule uniq_left[OF hPG hy hfold])
    show "zs \<in> gfun ` lsts (p - 1)"
    proof (rule image_eqI[of _ _ xs])
      show "zs = gfun xs" using zs_eq hyy by (simp add: gfun_def)
    next
      show "xs \<in> lsts (p - 1)" using hlen hxs unfolding lsts_def by simp
    qed
  next
    fix zs assume "zs \<in> gfun ` lsts (p - 1)"
    then obtain xs where hx: "xs \<in> lsts (p - 1)" and hz: "zs = gfun xs"
      by blast
    then have hl: "length xs = p - 1" and hs: "set xs \<subseteq> G"
      unfolding lsts_def by auto
    have hPG: "foldr mult xs e \<in> G" by (rule fold_mem[OF hs])
    have hgi: "ginv (foldr mult xs e) \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF hPG])
    have "foldr mult zs e = e"
      by (simp add: hz gfun_def fold_snoc[OF hs hgi] r_inv[OF hPG])
    moreover have "length zs = p" using hz hl hp by (simp add: gfun_def)
    moreover have "set zs \<subseteq> G" using hz hs hgi by (auto simp: gfun_def)
    ultimately show "zs \<in> SS p" unfolding SS_def lsts_def by simp
  qed
  have inj: "inj_on gfun (lsts (p - 1))"
    by (rule inj_onI) (metis butlast_snoc gfun_def)
  have cnt: "finite (lsts (p - 1)) \<and> card (lsts (p - 1)) = card G ^ (p - 1)"
    by (rule lsts_card[OF fG])
  have "finite (SS p)" unfolding eq by (rule finite_imageI) (rule conjunct1[OF cnt])
  moreover have "card (SS p) = card G ^ (p - 1)"
    unfolding eq by (subst card_image[OF inj]) (rule conjunct2[OF cnt])
  ultimately show ?thesis by blast
qed

lemma rot_mem:
  assumes hp: "0 < p" and hx: "xs \<in> SS p"
  shows "rotate1 xs \<in> SS p"
proof -
  have mem: "length xs = p \<and> set xs \<subseteq> G \<and> foldr mult xs e = e"
    using hx unfolding SS_def lsts_def by auto
  obtain x ys where xs: "xs = x # ys"
    using mem hp by (cases xs) auto
  have hxG: "x \<in> G" and hysG: "set ys \<subseteq> G" using mem xs by auto
  have hPy: "foldr mult ys e \<in> G" by (rule fold_mem[OF hysG])
  have hfx: "x \<cdot> foldr mult ys e = e" using mem xs by simp
  have hgy: "foldr mult ys e = ginv x" by (rule uniq_left[OF hxG hPy hfx])
  have hrot: "rotate1 xs = ys @ [x]" using xs by simp
  have hl': "length (ys @ [x]) = p" using mem xs by simp
  have hs': "set (ys @ [x]) \<subseteq> G" using mem xs by auto
  have hf': "foldr mult (ys @ [x]) e = e"
    by (simp add: fold_snoc[OF hysG hxG] hgy left_inv[OF hxG])
  show ?thesis
    unfolding SS_def lsts_def using hrot hl' hs' hf' by simp
qed

end

section \<open>Fixed points of rotation\<close>

lemma fixed_all: "ys @ [x] = x # ys \<Longrightarrow> \<forall>y\<in>set ys. y = x"
  by (induct ys) auto

lemma all_eq_replicate: "\<forall>y\<in>set ys. y = x \<Longrightarrow> ys = replicate (length ys) x"
  by (induct ys) auto

lemma fixed_rot:
  assumes ne: "xs \<noteq> []" and fx: "rotate1 xs = xs"
  shows "xs = replicate (length xs) (hd xs)"
proof -
  obtain x ys where hx: "xs = x # ys" using ne by (cases xs) auto
  have h1: "ys @ [x] = x # ys" using fx hx by simp
  have h2: "\<forall>y\<in>set ys. y = x" using fixed_all[OF h1] .
  have h3: "ys = replicate (length ys) x" using all_eq_replicate[OF h2] .
  have h4: "xs = x # replicate (length ys) x"
    by (subst hx) (rule arg_cong[OF h3, of "Cons x"])
  show ?thesis by (simp add: h4)
qed

lemma rot_iter: "length xs = n \<Longrightarrow> (rotate1 ^^ n) xs = xs"
proof -
  assume hl: "length xs = n"
  have "rotate n xs = xs" by (rule rotate_id) (simp add: hl)
  then show ?thesis by (simp add: rotate_def)
qed

text \<open>

  product \<open>e\<close>.  Its size is \<open>|G|^(p-1)\<close>, which is divisible by \<open>p\<close>.  The cyclic
  rotation acts on \<open>S\<close> with order dividing \<open>p\<close>, so the number of fixed points is
  divisible by \<open>p\<close> as well.  The constant tuple \<open>(e, \<dots>, e)\<close> is a fixed point, hence there
  is a second fixed point \<open>(x, \<dots>, x)\<close> with \<open>x \<noteq> e\<close> and \<open>x\<^sup>p = e\<close>.  Since \<open>p\<close> is prime,

section \<open>Iterates of a function\<close>

lemma it_split: "(f ^^ (a + b)) x = (f ^^ a) ((f ^^ b) x)"
  by (simp add: funpow_add)

lemma it_fix: "f y = y \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ m) y = y"
  by (induct m) auto

lemma it_add:
  assumes ha: "(f ^^ a) z = z" and hb: "(f ^^ b) z = z"
  shows "(f ^^ (a + b)) z = z"
  by (simp add: it_split hb ha)

lemma it_mult:
  assumes ha: "(f ^^ a) z = z"
  shows "(f ^^ (a * k)) z = z"
proof (induct k)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc k)
  have "(f ^^ (a * Suc k)) z = (f ^^ (a * k + a)) z"
    by (simp add: algebra_simps)
  also have "\<dots> = z"
    by (rule it_add[OF Suc.hyps ha])
  finally show ?case .
qed

lemma it_sub:
  assumes ha: "(f ^^ a) z = z" and hb: "(f ^^ b) z = z" and hle: "b \<le> a"
  shows "(f ^^ (a - b)) z = z"
proof -
  have e1: "(f ^^ ((a - b) + b)) z = (f ^^ a) z"
    by (simp add: hle)
  have e2: "(f ^^ ((a - b) + b)) z = (f ^^ (a - b)) z"
    by (simp add: it_split hb)
  show ?thesis by (metis e1 e2 ha)
qed

text \<open>The stabiliser of a point is closed under gcd (Euclid's algorithm).\<close>

lemma it_gcd: "(f ^^ a) z = z \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ b) z = z \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd a b) z = z"
proof (induct a b rule: gcd_nat_induct)
  case (base m)
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (step m n hpos ih)
  show ?case
  proof (intro impI)
    assume hm: "(f ^^ m) z = z" and hn: "(f ^^ n) z = z"
    have h1: "(f ^^ (n * (m div n))) z = z"
      by (rule it_mult[OF hn])
    have h2: "(f ^^ (m mod n + n * (m div n))) z = (f ^^ (m mod n)) z"
      by (simp add: it_split h1)
    have h3: "m mod n + n * (m div n) = m"
      using div_mult_mod_eq[of m n] by (simp add: add.commute)
    have hmod: "(f ^^ (m mod n)) z = z"
      using h2 h3 hm by (metis)
    have "(f ^^ gcd n (m mod n)) z = z"
      using ih hn hmod by blast
    moreover have "gcd m n = gcd n (m mod n)"
      by (rule gcd_non_0_nat) (use hpos in simp)
    ultimately show "(f ^^ gcd m n) z = z" by simp
  qed
qed

lemma prime_gcd1: "prime p \<Longrightarrow> 0 < k \<Longrightarrow> k < p \<Longrightarrow> gcd k p = 1"
proof -
  assume pp: "prime p" and k0: "0 < k" and kp: "k < p"
  have hp: "\<forall>d. d dvd p \<longrightarrow> d = 1 \<or> d = p"
    using pp unfolding prime_def by blast
  have d: "gcd k p dvd p" by simp
  from hp d have "gcd k p = 1 \<or> gcd k p = p" by blast
  moreover have "gcd k p \<noteq> p"
  proof
    assume "gcd k p = p"
    then have "p dvd k" using gcd_dvd1[of k p] by simp
    then have "p \<le> k" using k0 dvd_imp_le by blast
    with kp show False by simp
  qed
  ultimately show ?thesis by blast
qed

lemma prime_fix:
  assumes pp: "prime p" and k0: "0 < k" and kp: "k < p"
    and hk: "(f ^^ k) z = z" and hp: "(f ^^ p) z = z"
  shows "f z = z"
proof -
  have g: "(f ^^ gcd k p) z = z"
    by (rule it_gcd[OF hk hp])
  have g1: "gcd k p = 1"
    by (rule prime_gcd1[OF pp k0 kp])
  have "(f ^^ 1) z = z"
    using g by (simp add: g1)
  then show ?thesis by simp
qed

lemma orbit_inj:
  assumes pp: "prime p" and hij: "i < j" and hjp: "j < p"
    and hx: "(f ^^ p) x = x" and eq: "(f ^^ i) x = (f ^^ j) x"
  shows "f x = x"
proof -
  have e1: "p - i + i = p" using hij hjp by omega
  have e2: "p - i + j = (j - i) + p" using hij hjp by omega
  have s1: "(f ^^ p) x = (f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ i) x)"
    by (metis e1 it_split)
  have s2: "(f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ j) x) = (f ^^ (j - i)) x"
  proof -
    have "(f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ j) x) = (f ^^ (p - i + j)) x"
      by (simp add: it_split)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ ((j - i) + p)) x"
      by (simp add: e2)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (j - i)) ((f ^^ p) x)"
      by (simp add: it_split)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (j - i)) x"
      by (simp add: hx)
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  have hd: "(f ^^ (j - i)) x = x"
  proof -
    have "x = (f ^^ p) x" by (simp add: hx)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ i) x)" by (rule s1)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ j) x)" by (simp add: eq)
    also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (j - i)) x" by (rule s2)
    finally show ?thesis by simp
  qed
  have d1: "0 < j - i" using hij by omega
  have d2: "j - i < p" using hij hjp by omega
  show ?thesis by (rule prime_fix[OF pp d1 d2 hd hx])
qed

lemma it_inv:
  assumes hS: "\<forall>x\<in>S. f x \<in> S" and hy: "y \<in> S"
  shows "(f ^^ k) y \<in> S"
proof (induct k)
  case 0
  then show ?case by (simp add: hy)
next
  case (Suc k)
  have "(f ^^ Suc k) y = f ((f ^^ k) y)" by simp
  then show ?case using hS Suc.hyps by auto
qed

section \<open>Counting fixed points of a permutation of order dividing a prime\<close>

text \<open>If \<open>f\<close> has \<open>f^p = id\<close> on a finite invariant set \<open>S\<close>, then \<open>|S|\<close> and the
  number of fixed points of \<open>f\<close> in \<open>S\<close> agree modulo \<open>p\<close>.  The proof splits \<open>S\<close>
  into orbits of size \<open>p\<close> (no orbit of size 1 besides the fixed points).\<close>

lemma orbit_decomp:
  fixes f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a" and p :: nat
  assumes pp: "prime p"
  shows "\<forall>S. finite S \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>S. f x \<in> S) \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>S. (f ^^ p) x = x)
           \<longrightarrow> (\<exists>k. card S = card {x\<in>S. f x = x} + p * k)"
proof (intro allI)
  fix S :: "'a set"
  show "finite S \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>S. f x \<in> S) \<longrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>S. (f ^^ p) x = x)
           \<longrightarrow> (\<exists>k. card S = card {x\<in>S. f x = x} + p * k)"
  proof (induct S rule: finite_psubset_induct)
    case (psubset S hfin ih)
    show ?case
    proof (intro impI)
      assume invS: "\<forall>x\<in>S. f x \<in> S" and invP: "\<forall>x\<in>S. (f ^^ p) x = x"
      have hp0: "0 < p" using pp unfolding prime_def by auto
      show "\<exists>k. card S = card {x\<in>S. f x = x} + p * k"
      proof (cases "\<forall>x\<in>S. f x = x")
        case True
        have "{x\<in>S. f x = x} = S" using True by auto
        then have "card S = card {x\<in>S. f x = x} + p * 0" by simp
        then show ?thesis by blast
      next
        case False
        then obtain x0 where x0S: "x0 \<in> S" and fx0: "f x0 \<noteq> x0" by blast
        have hpx: "(f ^^ p) x0 = x0" using invP x0S by blast
        define O where "O = (\<lambda>k. (f ^^ k) x0) ` {..<p}"
        have Ofin: "finite O" unfolding O_def by simp
        have Oin: "O \<subseteq> S"
          unfolding O_def using invS x0S by (auto intro: it_inv)
        have x0O: "x0 \<in> O"
          unfolding O_def by (rule image_eqI[where x=0]) (simp_all add: hp0)
        have inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>k. (f ^^ k) x0) {..<p}"
        proof (rule inj_onI)
          fix a b
          assume ha: "a \<in> {..<p}" and hb: "b \<in> {..<p}"
            and eq: "(f ^^ a) x0 = (f ^^ b) x0"
          have ap: "a < p" using ha by simp
          have bp: "b < p" using hb by simp
          show "a = b"
          proof (rule ccontr)
            assume neq: "a \<noteq> b"
            have "f x0 = x0"
            proof (cases "a < b")
              case True
              then show ?thesis using orbit_inj[OF pp True bp hpx eq] .
            next
              case False
              then have blt: "b < a" using neq by linarith
              then show ?thesis using orbit_inj[OF pp blt ap hpx eq[symmetric]] .
            qed
            with fx0 show False by contradiction
          qed
        qed
        have cardO: "card O = p"
          unfolding O_def by (subst card_image[OF inj]) simp
        have Oinv: "\<forall>y\<in>O. f y \<in> O"
        proof (intro ballI)
          fix y assume "y \<in> O"
          then obtain k where kp: "k < p" and yk: "y = (f ^^ k) x0"
            unfolding O_def by auto
          show "f y \<in> O"
          proof (cases "Suc k < p")
            case True
            have "f y = (f ^^ Suc k) x0" using yk by simp
            then show ?thesis unfolding O_def
              by (rule image_eqI[where x="Suc k"]) (simp_all add: True)
          next
            case False
            have "f y = (f ^^ p) x0"
            proof -
              have "k + 1 = p" using kp False by simp
              then have "f y = (f ^^ (k + 1)) x0" using yk by simp
              then show ?thesis using \<open>k + 1 = p\<close> by simp
            qed
            then have "f y = x0" using hpx by simp
            then show ?thesis using x0O by simp
          qed
        qed
        have fixO: "\<forall>y\<in>O. f y \<noteq> y"
        proof (intro ballI notI)
          fix y assume yO: "y \<in> O" and fy: "f y = y"
          then obtain k where kp: "k < p" and yk: "y = (f ^^ k) x0"
            unfolding O_def by auto
          have c1: "(f ^^ (p - k)) y = y" by (rule it_fix[OF fy])
          have c2: "(f ^^ (p - k)) y = x0"
          proof -
            have "p - k + k = p" using kp by simp
            then have "(f ^^ p) x0 = (f ^^ (p - k)) ((f ^^ k) x0)"
              by (metis it_split)
            then show ?thesis using yk hpx by simp
          qed
          have "y = x0" using c1 c2 by simp
          then have "f x0 = x0" using fy by simp
          with fx0 show False by contradiction
        qed
        have Sdiff: "S - O \<subset> S" using x0S x0O by auto
        have invSO: "\<forall>y\<in>S - O. f y \<in> S - O"
        proof (intro ballI)
          fix y assume yS: "y \<in> S - O"
          then have ys: "y \<in> S" and yO: "y \<notin> O" by auto
          have fyS: "f y \<in> S" using invS ys by blast
          have fyO: "f y \<notin> O"
          proof
            assume fyO: "f y \<in> O"
            have back: "(f ^^ (p - 1)) (f y) \<in> O"
              by (rule it_inv[OF Oinv fyO])
            have "(f ^^ (p - 1 + 1)) y = (f ^^ (p - 1)) (f y)"
              by (simp add: it_split)
            moreover have "p - 1 + 1 = p" using hp0 by simp
            ultimately have "(f ^^ (p - 1)) (f y) = y"
              using invP ys by (metis)
            then show False using back yO by simp
          qed
          then show "f y \<in> S - O" using fyS by simp
        qed
        have invP': "\<forall>y\<in>S - O. (f ^^ p) y = y" using invP by auto
        obtain k where kS: "card (S - O) = card {x\<in>S - O. f x = x} + p * k"
          using ih Sdiff \<open>finite S\<close> invSO invP' by blast
        have fixeq: "{x\<in>S - O. f x = x} = {x\<in>S. f x = x}"
          using fixO by auto
        have cardSO: "card S = card (S - O) + p"
        proof -
          have "card (S - O) = card S - card O"
            by (rule card_Diff_subset[OF Ofin Oin])
          moreover have "card O \<le> card S" by (rule card_mono[OF hfin Oin])
          ultimately show ?thesis using cardO by linarith
        qed
        have "card S = card {x\<in>S. f x = x} + p * (k + 1)"
          using cardSO kS fixeq by (simp add: algebra_simps)
        then show ?thesis by blast
      qed
    qed
  qed
qed

section \<open>Basic group facts from the left axioms\<close>

context grp
begin

lemma r_inv: "x \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> x \<cdot> ginv x = e"
proof -
  assume hx: "x \<in> G"
  have hy: "ginv x \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF hx])
  have hz: "ginv (ginv x) \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF hy])
  have h1: "ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> ginv x = e" by (rule left_inv[OF hy])
  have h2: "ginv x \<cdot> x = e" by (rule left_inv[OF hx])
  have hxy: "x \<cdot> ginv x \<in> G" by (rule closed[OF hx hy])
  have "x \<cdot> ginv x = e \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x)" by (simp add: left_unit[OF hxy])
  also have "\<dots> = (ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x)" by (simp add: h1)
  also have "\<dots> = ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> (ginv x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x))"
    by (rule assoc[OF hz hy hxy])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> ((ginv x \<cdot> x) \<cdot> ginv x)"
    by (simp add: assoc[OF hy hx hy])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> (e \<cdot> ginv x)" by (simp add: h2)
  also have "\<dots> = ginv (ginv x) \<cdot> ginv x" by (simp add: left_unit[OF hy])
  also have "\<dots> = e" by (rule h1)
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma r_unit: "x \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> x \<cdot> e = x"
proof -
  assume hx: "x \<in> G"
  have hi: "ginv x \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF hx])
  have "x \<cdot> e = x \<cdot> (ginv x \<cdot> x)" by (simp add: left_inv[OF hx])
  also have "\<dots> = (x \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> x" by (simp add: assoc[OF hx hi hx])
  also have "\<dots> = x" by (simp add: r_inv[OF hx] left_unit[OF hx])
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma uniq_left: "a \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> a \<cdot> y = e \<Longrightarrow> y = ginv a"
proof -
  assume ha: "a \<in> G" and hy: "y \<in> G" and h: "a \<cdot> y = e"
  have hi: "ginv a \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF ha])
  have "y = e \<cdot> y" by (simp add: left_unit[OF hy])
  also have "\<dots> = (ginv a \<cdot> a) \<cdot> y" by (simp add: left_inv[OF ha])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv a \<cdot> (a \<cdot> y)" by (simp add: assoc[OF hi ha hy])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv a" by (simp add: h r_unit[OF hi])
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma fold_mem: "set xs \<subseteq> G \<Longrightarrow> foldr mult xs e \<in> G"
  by (induct xs) (auto intro: closed unit_closed)

lemma fold_snoc: "set xs \<subseteq> G \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> foldr mult (xs @ [y]) e = foldr mult xs e \<cdot> y"
proof (induct xs)
  case Nil
  show ?case
  proof (intro impI)
    assume hy: "y \<in> G"
    show "foldr mult ([] @ [y]) e = foldr mult [] e \<cdot> y"
      by (simp add: r_unit[OF hy] left_unit[OF hy])
  qed
next
  case (Cons x xs)
  show ?case
  proof (intro impI)
    assume hs: "set (x # xs) \<subseteq> G" and hy: "y \<in> G"
    have hx: "x \<in> G" using hs by simp
    have hxs: "set xs \<subseteq> G" using hs by simp
    have hp: "foldr mult xs e \<in> G" by (rule fold_mem[OF hxs])
    have "foldr mult ((x # xs) @ [y]) e = x \<cdot> (foldr mult xs e \<cdot> y)"
      by (simp add: Cons.hyps[OF hxs hy])
    also have "\<dots> = (x \<cdot> foldr mult xs e) \<cdot> y"
      by (simp add: assoc[OF hx hp hy])
    finally show "foldr mult ((x # xs) @ [y]) e = foldr mult (x # xs) e \<cdot> y" by simp
  qed
qed

lemma pow_rep: "foldr mult (replicate n x) e = pow x n"
  by (induct n) simp_all

lemma pow_e: "pow e n = e"
proof (induct n)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  then show ?case by (simp add: left_unit[OF unit_closed])
qed

lemma iter_pow: "((\<lambda>y. x \<cdot> y) ^^ k) e = pow x k"
  by (induct k) simp_all

definition lsts :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a list set"
  where "lsts n = {xs. length xs = n \<and> set xs \<subseteq> G}"

definition SS :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a list set"
  where "SS n = {xs \<in> lsts n. foldr mult xs e = e}"

definition gfun :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a list"
  where "gfun xs = xs @ [ginv (foldr mult xs e)]"

lemma lsts_card:
  assumes fG: "finite G"
  shows "finite (lsts n) \<and> card (lsts n) = card G ^ n"
proof (induct n)
  case 0
  have "lsts 0 = {[]}" unfolding lsts_def by auto
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  have eq: "lsts (Suc n) = (\<lambda>(x, ys). x # ys) ` (G \<times> lsts n)"
  proof (intro equalityI subsetI)
    fix zs assume hz: "zs \<in> lsts (Suc n)"
    then obtain x ys where zs: "zs = x # ys"
      unfolding lsts_def by (cases zs) auto
    show "zs \<in> (\<lambda>(x, ys). x # ys) ` (G \<times> lsts n)"
    proof (rule image_eqI[of _ _ "(x, ys)"])
      show "zs = (\<lambda>(x, ys). x # ys) (x, ys)" using zs by simp
    next
      show "(x, ys) \<in> G \<times> lsts n" using hz zs unfolding lsts_def by auto
    qed
  next
    fix zs assume "zs \<in> (\<lambda>(x, ys). x # ys) ` (G \<times> lsts n)"
    then obtain x ys where hx: "x \<in> G" and hys: "ys \<in> lsts n" and zs: "zs = x # ys"
      by auto
    then show "zs \<in> lsts (Suc n)" unfolding lsts_def by auto
  qed
  have inj: "inj_on (\<lambda>(x, ys). x # ys) (G \<times> lsts n)"
    by (auto simp: inj_on_def)
  have fin: "finite (lsts (Suc n))"
    unfolding eq by (rule finite_imageI) (rule finite_cartesian_product[OF fG conjunct1[OF Suc]])
  have card_eq: "card (lsts (Suc n)) = card G * card (lsts n)"
    unfolding eq by (subst card_image[OF inj]) (simp add: card_cartesian_product)
  show ?case using fin card_eq Suc by (simp add: power_Suc)
qed

lemma SS_card:
  assumes fG: "finite G" and hp: "0 < p"
  shows "finite (SS p) \<and> card (SS p) = card G ^ (p - 1)"
proof -
  have eq: "SS p = gfun ` lsts (p - 1)"
  proof (intro equalityI subsetI)
    fix zs assume hz: "zs \<in> SS p"
    then have mem: "length zs = p \<and> set zs \<subseteq> G \<and> foldr mult zs e = e"
      unfolding SS_def lsts_def by auto
    have hne: "zs \<noteq> []" using mem hp by auto
    define xs where "xs = butlast zs"
    define y where "y = last zs"
    have zs_eq: "zs = xs @ [y]"
      unfolding xs_def y_def using hne by simp
    have hlen: "length xs = p - 1" unfolding xs_def using mem by simp
    have hxs: "set xs \<subseteq> G" unfolding xs_def using mem by (auto dest: in_set_butlastD)
    have hy: "y \<in> G" unfolding y_def using mem hne by (auto intro: last_in_set)
    have hfold: "foldr mult xs e \<cdot> y = e"
      using mem zs_eq fold_snoc[OF hxs hy] by simp
    have hPG: "foldr mult xs e \<in> G" by (rule fold_mem[OF hxs])
    have hyy: "y = ginv (foldr mult xs e)" by (rule uniq_left[OF hPG hy hfold])
    show "zs \<in> gfun ` lsts (p - 1)"
    proof (rule image_eqI[of _ _ xs])
      show "zs = gfun xs" using zs_eq hyy by (simp add: gfun_def)
    next
      show "xs \<in> lsts (p - 1)" using hlen hxs unfolding lsts_def by simp
    qed
  next
    fix zs assume "zs \<in> gfun ` lsts (p - 1)"
    then obtain xs where hx: "xs \<in> lsts (p - 1)" and hz: "zs = gfun xs"
      by blast
    then have hl: "length xs = p - 1" and hs: "set xs \<subseteq> G"
      unfolding lsts_def by auto
    have hPG: "foldr mult xs e \<in> G" by (rule fold_mem[OF hs])
    have hgi: "ginv (foldr mult xs e) \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF hPG])
    have "foldr mult zs e = e"
      by (simp add: hz gfun_def fold_snoc[OF hs hgi] r_inv[OF hPG])
    moreover have "length zs = p" using hz hl hp by (simp add: gfun_def)
    moreover have "set zs \<subseteq> G" using hz hs hgi by (auto simp: gfun_def)
    ultimately show "zs \<in> SS p" unfolding SS_def lsts_def by simp
  qed
  have inj: "inj_on gfun (lsts (p - 1))"
    by (rule inj_onI) (metis butlast_snoc gfun_def)
  have cnt: "finite (lsts (p - 1)) \<and> card (lsts (p - 1)) = card G ^ (p - 1)"
    by (rule lsts_card[OF fG])
  have "finite (SS p)" unfolding eq by (rule finite_imageI) (rule conjunct1[OF cnt])
  moreover have "card (SS p) = card G ^ (p - 1)"
    unfolding eq by (subst card_image[OF inj]) (rule conjunct2[OF cnt])
  ultimately show ?thesis by blast
qed

lemma rot_mem:
  assumes hp: "0 < p" and hx: "xs \<in> SS p"
  shows "rotate1 xs \<in> SS p"
proof -
  have mem: "length xs = p \<and> set xs \<subseteq> G \<and> foldr mult xs e = e"
    using hx unfolding SS_def lsts_def by auto
  obtain x ys where xs: "xs = x # ys"
    using mem hp by (cases xs) auto
  have hxG: "x \<in> G" and hysG: "set ys \<subseteq> G" using mem xs by auto
  have hPy: "foldr mult ys e \<in> G" by (rule fold_mem[OF hysG])
  have hfx: "x \<cdot> foldr mult ys e = e" using mem xs by simp
  have hgy: "foldr mult ys e = ginv x" by (rule uniq_left[OF hxG hPy hfx])
  have hrot: "rotate1 xs = ys @ [x]" using xs by simp
  have hl': "length (ys @ [x]) = p" using mem xs by simp
  have hs': "set (ys @ [x]) \<subseteq> G" using mem xs by auto
  have hf': "foldr mult (ys @ [x]) e = e"
    by (simp add: fold_snoc[OF hysG hxG] hgy left_inv[OF hxG])
  show ?thesis
    unfolding SS_def lsts_def using hrot hl' hs' hf' by simp
qed

section \<open>Fixed points of rotation\<close>

lemma fixed_all: "ys @ [x] = x # ys \<Longrightarrow> \<forall>y\<in>set ys. y = x"
  by (induct ys) auto

lemma all_eq_replicate: "\<forall>y\<in>set ys. y = x \<Longrightarrow> ys = replicate (length ys) x"
  by (induct ys) auto

lemma fixed_rot:
  assumes ne: "xs \<noteq> []" and fx: "rotate1 xs = xs"
  shows "xs = replicate (length xs) (hd xs)"
proof -
  obtain x ys where hx: "xs = x # ys" using ne by (cases xs) auto
  have h1: "ys @ [x] = x # ys" using fx hx by simp
  have h2: "\<forall>y\<in>set ys. y = x" using fixed_all[OF h1] .
  have h3: "ys = replicate (length ys) x" using all_eq_replicate[OF h2] .
  have h4: "xs = x # replicate (length ys) x"
    by (subst hx) (rule arg_cong[OF h3, of "Cons x"])
  show ?thesis by (simp add: h4)
qed

lemma rot_iter: "length xs = n \<Longrightarrow> (rotate1 ^^ n) xs = xs"
proof -
  assume hl: "length xs = n"
  have "rotate n xs = xs" by (rule rotate_id) (simp add: hl)
  then show ?thesis by (simp add: rotate_def)
qed
